* Jetpacs Action Reference

GENERATED from =ebp/contract.json= (the =actions= registry), the
renderer's =NodeSupport.kt= advertisement sets, and examples
*executed* through =jetpacs-action= in a batch Emacs — the wire
payloads below are =json-serialize= of real constructor output.
=contract.json= is authoritative; this table is orientation
(SPEC §24.4: a projection gates shapes, never behavior).

** 1. Remote ActionDescriptor (SPEC §14.1)

Constructor: =jetpacs-action= (jetpacs-widgets.el).  An action name
MUST be a §4.4 namespaced identifier containing at least one dot;
dotless names are rejected at build time.

| Member | Presence | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| =action= | required | — |
| =args= | optional | plain application data (object) |
| =when_offline= | optional | one of =drop= / =queue= / =wake=; default =drop= |
| =dedupe= | optional | identifier; forbidden for =drop=; the key space is flat per pairing identity (SPEC §15.2, amendment #144) |
| =ttl_s= | optional | REQUIRED for =queue=/=wake=; forbidden for =drop= |
| =confirm= | optional | non-empty string; native confirmation before the event |
| =capture_fields= | optional | distinct stateful widget IDs captured atomically |

** 2. Executed examples

Each row was built by the generator in a live batch Emacs; if a
form stops building, generation fails.

- Form: =(jetpacs-action "note.open" :args '(:id "20260731T120000"))=
  - Result: =(:action "note.open" :args (:id "20260731T120000"))=
  - Wire: ={"action":"note.open","args":{"id":"20260731T120000"}}=
- Form: =(jetpacs-action "note.save" :when-offline "queue" :ttl-s 3600 :dedupe "note:20260731T120000")=
  - Result: =(:action "note.save" :when_offline "queue" :dedupe "note:20260731T120000" :ttl_s 3600)=
  - Wire: ={"action":"note.save","when_offline":"queue","dedupe":"note:20260731T120000","ttl_s":3600}=
- Form: =(jetpacs-action "heading.todo-set" :args '(:state "DONE") :confirm "Mark this item done?")=
  - Result: =(:action "heading.todo-set" :args (:state "DONE") :confirm "Mark this item done?")=
  - Wire: ={"action":"heading.todo-set","args":{"state":"DONE"},"confirm":"Mark this item done?"}=
- Form: =(jetpacs-action "note.search" :capture-fields '("q"))=
  - Result: =(:action "note.search" :capture_fields ["q"])=
  - Wire: ={"action":"note.search","capture_fields":["q"]}=

** 3. Local builtins

There is NO =jetpacs-builtin= constructor: builtins are authored as
literal plists on a hook, e.g. =:on_tap (:builtin "view.switch" :view "profile")=,
which serializes to ={"builtin":"view.switch","view":"profile"}=.

| Builtin | Required members | Optional members | Advertised by |
|---|---|---|---|
| =clipboard.copy= | =builtin=, =text= | — | app profile |
| =companion.settings.open= | =builtin= | — | app profile |
| =dialog.dismiss= | =builtin= | — | dialog profile |
| =dialog.submit= | =builtin= | =value=, =capture_fields= | dialog profile |
| =share.send= | =builtin=, =text= | =title= | app profile |
| =trigger.fire= | =builtin=, =id= | — | app profile |
| =view.switch= | =builtin=, =view= | — | app profile |
